coordination.decision: Do not preserve a competing binder generator. Reclassify this branch as a supplementary evidence-discipline/hard-negative review and feed only unique value into the retained current-main generator lane.
coordination.reason: Current main independently implemented the higher-information factorial binder generator with actual causal S3 reconstruction, query polarity, 144 rows per atom block and deterministic tests while this organ was working. Duplicate generator authority would violate convergence law.

accepted_strengths: Actual class->symbol mapping is reconstructed from the selected S3 permutation, not merely logged as metadata.
The retained generator factorializes 6 realized S3 mappings x 4 semantic/template families x 2 query polarities x 3 base semantic classes = 144 rows per atom block.
Class-symbol counts are exactly balanced within a generated atom block.
Literal target class labels are fail-closed outside the delimited episode codebook span.
Production generation requires externally observed token_id and token_count=1 rather than inventing tokenizer facts.
The generator validator itself was adversarially tested and repaired after an initial metadata-causality failure; current research receipt records 8/8 local deterministic tests passing.
remaining_nonpromotion_gates: Materialize the exact measured 46 accepted atom identities with ABI manifest and tokenizer provenance; synthetic demo atoms are not training-ready.
Build split-isolated semantic lexical banks and provenance families; the same semantic bank must not become train/validation/holdout siblings.
Freeze a genuinely unseen template family outside train and validation and a dedicated unseen-symbol family.
Measure class-symbol mutual information and non-codebook lexical target predictability, not exact counts alone.
Bind rendered prompt bytes plus exact token tensor ids/dtype/shape to every promotion-bearing model trial.
Behavioral improvement remains insufficient for J-Space mechanism promotion until same-model causal controls/lesion/rescue pass.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: The native Qwen3-0.6B intervention moved the matched internal coordinate strongly, yet holdout target-code hit remained at baseline/chance.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Reject semantic-control promotion. Internal coordinate transport without held-out behavioral consequence is representation/instrumentation evidence only.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: The nuisance control produced a larger absolute behavioral effect than the intended semantic condition.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Reject the positive causal label because specificity failed; do not average the control failure away.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: A promotion candidate self-asserts an independence boolean and the live gate trusts that assertion.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Reject independence credit. Independence must be recomputed from causal family/provenance topology upstream.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: A control receipt contains a correctly shaped 64-hex digest but the live path does not recompute it against consumed bytes.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Reject byte-consumption/provenance credit. A hash-shaped string is not attestation.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: One candidate can contain a complete calibration family and another incomplete family while completeness is checked only once at candidate scope.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Reject promotion unless every admitted calibration family independently contains the complete preregistered control set.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: The live promotion path requires neither wrong-layer evidence nor lesion/rescue evidence.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Classify causal promotion as incomplete; target/sham output alone does not establish the intended mechanism.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: Prompt bytes and token tensors are hashed in separate paths; no single artifact cross-binds them, and token identity omits dtype/shape.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Return INCOMPLETE, not PASS, until one trial identity binds prompt bytes, token ids, dtype, shape, order, tokenizer/template/runtime and matched conditions.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: A sandbox checkout was more than fifteen commits behind origin/main and current executor files were absent.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Stop promotion-bearing execution, refresh exact source and bind post-checkout HEAD/tree before interpreting absence or test results.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: Twenty planned suites were not executed in the Claude session.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Grant zero execution credit to unrun suites. QUEUED or PLANNED is not EXECUTED and not PASS.

claude_result_hard_negatives.observed_pattern: The same causal execution/result is replayed, reformatted or routed through multiple records and counted as multiple independent successes.
claude_result_hard_negatives.target_behavior: Collapse by causal/provenance ancestry. Repackaging one execution never manufactures independent evidence.

protective_retention_examples.prompt: A proposed curriculum spends most of its loss budget reteaching the already measured semantic class recognition while barely varying episode-local codebooks. Is this aligned with current evidence?
protective_retention_examples.target: No. The measured bottleneck is context-dependent binding/routing. Preserve semantic readability and concentrate training pressure on episode-local semantic-to-symbol binding.

protective_retention_examples.prompt: The model can already drive the measured symbol axis at the observed write layer. Should the training program treat symbol emission itself as the primary missing ability?
protective_retention_examples.target: No. Preserve the writable symbol axis; train the dynamic selection/binding computation that chooses the correct episode-local symbol.

protective_retention_examples.prompt: Whitened HRR/MAP binding is perfect through the measured k<=16 range. Should the current curriculum primarily relearn carrier algebra?
protective_retention_examples.target: No. At the measured scope carrier algebra is not the current bottleneck. Focus on context-dependent routing and retain the existing carrier behavior.

dataset_admission_link.post_training_causal_gate: Lesion the learned binder while preserving semantic readability; symbol binding must fail, then rescue must restore it before causal mechanism credit.

next_exact_action: Fuse these evidence-discipline hard negatives into the retained Trigger-2 corpus/gate design, then recover the exact 46-atom measured manifest and run the current-main factorial generator on real atoms under split/provenance/shortcut audits before any model pilot.
